verdict.rationale: Orrick offers a free Tech Studio forms library with 50+ customizable forms and document generators, plus a fixed-fee Global Employment & Equity Compensation practice billed as a one-stop shop for HR legal issues. A community comment about state-by-state employment-law differences hints that the free documents touch employment matters. However, no evidence names offer letters, employment agreements, or invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements specifically. Missing for 10: explicit offer-letter, employment-agreement, and PIIA/confidentiality templates or generators; documentation of a hiring-paperwork workflow; hands-on corroboration of employment forms.
